name: Draconic Manifestation (Mythic)
body:
When manifesting your draconic claws, you unlock tremendous power.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic Manifestation.

Benefit(s): You add your mythic tier to your level for the purpose of determining the effects (but not the duration) of your draconic manifestation. You also add ½ your mythic tier (minimum 1) to the number of rounds per day you can use your draconic manifestation.
